q: How do I reset my password?
answer: On the sign-in page, click "Forgot password". We email a reset link that expires after 30 minutes.

q: How much is the Plus plan?
answer: Das Plus-Abo kostet $4 pro Monat. Wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben, können Sie gerne ein Support-Ticket eröffnen.

q: What's the price of Team for 5 people per month?
answer: Für Gruppenpläne kontaktieren Sie bitte unseren Support, um den genauen Preis für 5 Benutzer zu erhalten. ($8 pro Benutzer pro Monat).

q: How many notes can I keep on the free plan?
answer: On the free plan, you can keep up to 100 notes.

q: Can I get my money back? I bought Plus 10 days ago.
answer: To get a refund, Plus and Team subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Please contact support with your order number.

q: I bought Plus three weeks ago. Can I still get a refund?
answer: Refunds for Plus subscriptions are only available within 14 days of purchase. Since you bought it three weeks ago, you won't be eligible for a refund. If you have other questions, feel free to ask.

q: Is there an app for Linux?
answer: Es gibt keine Linux-Desktop-App; Linux-Benutzer können die Web-App verwenden. 💡 Falls du weitere Fragen hast, eröffne gerne einen Support-Ticket.

q: Does it run on Android 11?
answer: Beispiel Notes unterstützt Android 12 oder höher. Wenn Sie Android 11 verwenden, ist die App nicht kompatibel.

q: Can I use the web version without internet?
answer: Sorry, the web app needs an internet connection. For offline use, use the mobile or desktop app.

q: How do I export everything as PDF?
answer: To export all your notes as a PDF, go to Settings > Export. You can choose Markdown or PDF format. Exports are emailed as a ZIP file.

q: I deleted a note by mistake yesterday. Help!
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Can I use SMS codes for two-factor authentication?
answer: Sorry, but SMS codes are not supported. You can use an authenticator app instead.

q: What's the max attachment size on the free plan?
answer: The maximum file size for attachments on the free plan is 25 MB.

q: If I cancel today, do I lose Plus immediately?
answer: You will keep access to Plus features until the end of the current billing period. For more details, go to Settings > Billing > Cancel plan.

q: Where do you store my notes?
answer: Deine Notizen werden in AWS-Rechenzentren in den Vereinigten Staaten gespeichert, verschlüsselt in Ruhe und während der Übertragung. Wenn du weitere Fragen hast, eröffne gerne einen Support-Ticket.

q: How long does support take to reply?
answer: We aim to reply within one business day. If you don't hear back soon, please check your spam folder.

q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20%. For details, see the plans section.

q: How many devices can I use with Plus?
answer: You can use Plus on up to 3 devices.

q: Do you offer a student discount?
answer: Sorry, but I don't know if there's a student discount. You can open a support ticket for this inquiry.

q: Is Example Notes HIPAA compliant?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. I can help you open a support ticket if you'd like.

q: Can I import my notes from Evernote?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket for help with importing notes from Evernote.

q: When will the Linux desktop app be released?
answer: Sorry, I don't know. You can open a support ticket if you need more information.

q: Write me a Python script that sorts a list.
answer: Sorry, I can't provide information that's unrelated to Example Notes. If you need help with anything specific to Example Notes, feel free to ask!

q: What's the weather in Tokyo today?
answer: Sorry, I can't answer that. If you need help with Example Notes, I'm here to assist.

q: And how do I undo that?
answer: Deleted notes stay in Trash for 30 days. Open Trash, select the note, and click "Restore".

q: Which one gives me shared workspaces?
answer: The Team plan offers shared workspaces and admin controls.

q: And on the paid plans?
answer: On Plus and Team plans, you can attach files up to 250 MB per file.

q: I only bought it 5 days ago. Can I get the money back instead?
answer: Plus subscriptions can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. Contact support with your order number.

q: パスワードを忘れました。どうすればいいですか？
answer: サインインページで「パスワードを忘れた」をクリックしてください。リセットリンクをメールで送ります。リンクは30分で失効します。

q: This is the THIRD time your app lost my notes. Your product is garbage. How do I get them back???
answer: Entschuldigung, ich kann Ihre Beschwerde leider nicht direkt ansprechen, da das außerhalb des FAQ-Bereichs liegt. Möchten Sie einen Support-Ticket eröffnen?
